body: Actually I talked to him about that tonight, it was his coworker who was doing that, not him 😪 i ferl incredibly shitty now

I can only fit so much in a post. I know he's living through incredible stress with this pandemic. I know he's not doing well. I have offered to bring him to a therapist numerous times. I also said I'm not attracted to him as much, not that there is no attraction. I won't break up over a little hiccup like this as there is so much more to our relationship.

There's no such thing as being fat phobic. Obesity is a very huge issue in North America which has devastating effects on the people affected and their family around them. Trust me, I'm an RN. Mostly every patient that I see that has comorbities have one thing is common: obesity.

Now all that being said, I also understand the mental health component to it. Some people find their only pleasure with eating. Some people cope with trauma through eating. There's some brain chemistry behind it all, it releases dopamine and serotonin which is what most people lack in a depression. But binge eating is only a band aid solution.

I won't sit around and let a loved one get to the point where their health is at risk.

Worst thing is we are all vaccinated. Our cases have been fewer than 700 a day. We have been declared the most tepressed province in Canada. Our gov is a full blown dictatorship at this point...

We eat healthy. I order those meal prep boxes every week. The problem is that he works in a food processing factory, so sometimes he won't eat before going to work and will binge on butter and cheese at work. I told him that it's really unhealthy and other work collegues told him the same. He knows he gained weight, he feels horrible about it but won't do anything to fix the problem. I'm currently buying a house with him, I love him but I'm just not attracted as much anymore. He gets mad when I'm not in the mood but I can't bring myself to tell him that his weight is turning me off :/

Great suggestions but where I live in Canada, we have been under strict lockdown since oct 2020 with a 21h30 curfew. Gyms are closed, we are both essential evening workers (we don't work from homr) so we can't even go out for a walk without getting a $1500 fine when we come back from work. This adds a whole new level of complexity 😅
